name: templates
description: Optional Bilingual Reader visual templates. Load this compact index first, shortlist from metadata, then inspect only the selected template file.

usage.selection: Read this index first to choose a visual direction from metadata without loading every template.
usage.final_generation: After selecting a template, use it as visual guidance and generate a static, human-editable index.html with content written directly into the DOM.
usage.never: Do not bulk-read assets/templates/*/template.html. Do not modify template source for single-article content. Do not invent article-specific template descriptions.

template_policy.content_model: article content belongs directly in the final HTML DOM; optional data.json must not be required for rendering
template_policy.description_model: When describing why a template was chosen or filling descriptive page modules, use only the approved source Markdown and this template metadata. Do not fabricate claims, sections, examples, captions, metrics, images, or article details that are not present in the source.
template_policy.source_image_model: Original-view images must come from the approved source only, appear in reading order, render centered, and use a bounded 720x405 image box with object-fit: contain instead of unconstrained dimensions.
template_policy.mobile_behavior: responsive layout may reflow reading panes while preserving bilingual readability

templates.name: aurora-dashboard
templates.tagline: Glassmorphism dashboard with luminous aurora gradients and information panels.
templates.layout: wide stat-free dashboard hero and neon glass reading cards
templates.best_for: Technology explainers, AI product reading notes, market analysis, research digests, and articles that benefit from a sharp analytical dashboard frame.
templates.avoid_for: Quiet literary essays, classical content, or dense legal text where glassy visual energy would distract from the reading.

templates.name: blueprint-grid
templates.tagline: Engineering blueprint on a dark cyan grid with specification-table reading rows.
templates.layout: technical drawing header, grid background, numbered bilingual specification rows
templates.best_for: Architecture, engineering, systems design, product specs, API concepts, and procedural articles that should feel measured and exact.
templates.avoid_for: Personal essays, warm lifestyle content, or playful education where the strict blueprint metaphor would feel cold.

templates.name: broadsheet
templates.tagline: Vintage newspaper broadsheet with masthead rules, columns, and editorial hierarchy.
templates.layout: masthead hero, newspaper columns, thin vertical dividers, fixed anchor navigation
templates.best_for: News analysis, policy commentary, historical writing, public-interest essays, and article translations that should read like a serious front page.
templates.avoid_for: Highly interactive study sessions or modern SaaS/product content that needs a lighter interface language.

templates.name: card-atlas
templates.tagline: Anchored article atlas with a sticky source card and numbered bilingual reading cards.
templates.layout: sticky hero/sidebar with indexed bilingual cards in the main reading lane
templates.best_for: Longform articles, source walkthroughs, concept maps, reading workshops, and content where section-to-section navigation matters.
templates.avoid_for: Very short texts or poster-like pages where the persistent atlas/sidebar would be unnecessary.

templates.name: command-center
templates.tagline: Kinetic command-center mosaic with a slim control dock and staggered reading stream.
templates.layout: vertical control dock, oversized hero, staggered bilingual cards, right-side anchors
templates.best_for: Strategic briefings, launch narratives, security or operations explainers, and articles that should feel active and decisive.
templates.avoid_for: Calm reflective prose, exam prep sheets, or contexts where movement and asymmetry would reduce concentration.

templates.name: compact-study
templates.tagline: High-density study sheet optimized for efficient bilingual review and vocabulary scanning.
templates.layout: narrow margins, numbered bilingual rows, compact cards, horizontal principle strips
templates.best_for: Exam review, intensive reading, vocabulary-heavy material, technical summaries, and users who want maximum information per screen.
templates.avoid_for: Presentation-like pages, literary atmosphere, or content where breathing room and emotion are more important than density.

templates.name: editorial-split
templates.tagline: Magazine-style split layout with oversized typography and wide bilingual columns.
templates.layout: large editorial hero with broad paired reading columns
templates.best_for: Essays, interviews, cultural commentary, design writing, and pieces where typography should carry the visual identity.
templates.avoid_for: Highly granular technical references or flashcard-like study material that needs many compact UI elements.

templates.name: gradient-magazine
templates.tagline: Colorful magazine treatment with vivid gradients, asymmetric hero composition, and energetic cards.
templates.layout: asymmetric hero, gradient surfaces, vivid section and summary cards
templates.best_for: Creative industry articles, lifestyle explainers, product storytelling, trend reports, and accessible educational content.
templates.avoid_for: Regulated disclosures, quiet academic reading, or content that requires visual restraint.

templates.name: ink-scroll
templates.tagline: Dark Chinese ink-wash scroll with seal accents, rice-paper panels, and literary pacing.
templates.layout: scroll-like header, seal hero, bilingual paper panels, cinnabar annotation cards
templates.best_for: Chinese cultural content, literary essays, history, philosophy, poetry-adjacent readings, and bilingual pages needing a refined traditional atmosphere.
templates.avoid_for: SaaS dashboards, operational briefings, or casual youth-oriented content where the heritage visual language would feel too solemn.

templates.name: kanban-flow
templates.tagline: Modern SaaS kanban board with workflow columns and pill badges.
templates.layout: project board header, stat-free hero, kanban section columns, task-card bilingual rows
templates.best_for: Product management, startup articles, workflow explainers, learning plans, execution checklists, and content that maps naturally to tasks or stages.
templates.avoid_for: Classical literary reading or highly emotional narratives where task-board framing would flatten the tone.

templates.name: midnight-lab
templates.tagline: Terminal-style midnight lab notebook with evidence blocks and assertion-like quizzes.
templates.layout: terminal top bar, experiment cover, stacked source/translation evidence blocks, conclusion lists
templates.best_for: Developer education, debugging stories, technical research, security analysis, and articles that benefit from a lab-record metaphor.
templates.avoid_for: Warm consumer-facing content or traditional print-style essays where terminal aesthetics would be too narrow.

templates.name: mono-focus
templates.tagline: Monospace dossier workspace with command-line panels and scanline navigation.
templates.layout: command-line panels, compact reading workspace, scanline-style navigation
templates.best_for: Code-adjacent articles, research notes, investigative summaries, concise briefs, and readers who prefer a low-distraction technical interface.
templates.avoid_for: Design-forward editorials, cultural-literary pieces, or highly visual narratives needing expressive typography.

templates.name: paper-notes
templates.tagline: Soft paper-note timeline that turns bilingual reading into a route of learning stops.
templates.layout: capsule header, station-style hero, vertical timeline stops, checkpoint quiz cards
templates.best_for: Beginner-friendly reading, classroom handouts, guided learning journeys, reflective articles, and content that should feel clear without being severe.
templates.avoid_for: Hard technical specs, urgent briefings, or dark cinematic content that needs stronger contrast and authority.

templates.name: synthwave-arcade
templates.tagline: Retro synthwave arcade interface with neon scanlines, grid horizon, and level panels.
templates.layout: neon top bar, scanline horizon background, arcade hero, level-based bilingual panels
templates.best_for: Gaming, internet culture, youth technology, creative coding, hackathon recaps, and articles that can benefit from nostalgic digital energy.
templates.avoid_for: Healthcare, finance, legal, or any context where neon playfulness would undermine trust.
